title: PipelineRunRecord
description: A single persisted pipeline run as returned by GET /api/pipelines/:id/run-history. `triggerSource` records how the run was started (HEL-417): `manual` (user-submitted via the run API, including dry runs), `scheduled` (fired by the scheduler runtime, HEL-415), or `external` (POST /api/hooks/run, HEL-369). `triggeredByTokenId` (HEL-369) is present when a PAT authenticated the triggering request. `assertions` (HEL-576) is the run's pass/fail-by-severity assertion summary -- always present, zero-valued when the pipeline had no `assert` steps.

AssertionFailureDetail.description: One failing assertion rule's detail. `failures` carries only the FAILED results.

TruncatedReadResponse.description: One truncated read (HEL-861), primary source included when it was itself truncated.

RunTruncationRecord.description: HEL-873: the persisted three-state truncation signal. `truncated` is run-wide and derived from `reads.nonEmpty` -- never an independently-writable flag. `reads` is ALWAYS present on this object (present-and-empty beats absent, HEL-890) -- empty on a recorded, complete run. This whole object being ABSENT from `PipelineRunRecord.truncation` is the distinct NOT-RECORDED state, never confusable with `truncated: false`.

truncation.description: HEL-873: absent means NOT RECORDED (predates this capability, or the run has not reached a terminal status) -- never rendered as `truncated: false`.
